_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Kamu lagèe Golf (Ureuëng Game) - Ureuëng {player_id}.
Tujuan: Dapeuta nilai poin paléng randah lam ronde tunggal nyoe. Meunyoë kolom na keuh nilai, banda nyang geusumah 0.
Nilai Ureuëng: A=1, 2-10=nilai muka, J/Q=10, K=0

Peurintah (gunayana kurungan teupat):
- '[draw]' - Kureuëng dari dek
- '[take]' - Kureuëng dari tumpukan buwang
- '[swap X Y]' - Geutukar ureuëng nyang kureuëng ngon posisi X (baré) Y (kolom)
- '[discard]' - Buwang ureuëng nyang kureuëng

board.drew:
Kamu kureuëng: {card}
Jinoe kamu wajéb [swap X Y] atawa [discard] banda.
board.took:
Kamu kureuëng: {card} nibak tumpukan buwang
Kamu wajéb [swap X Y] ngon banda (h'an buwang).

options.final_turns: Giliran akhé! Peurintah droe: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Awak harus: [swap X Y] (hana jeut tapeulaku kartu dari tumpukan peuleusu)

message.knocked: Ureuëng {pid} ketok! Ureuëng la'én na geubri satu giliran deui.
message.final_round: Ureuëng {pid} {reason}! Ureuëng la'én na geubri satu giliran deui.

invalid.wrong_action: Gunayana kurungan peurintah saboh: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], atawa [peek X Y]
invalid.must_draw_first: Kamu wajéb kureuëng [draw], [take], [knock], atawa [peek X Y] phôn
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Droeneuh hanjeut tapeulaku kartu nyang ka teucok nibak tumpukan. Droeneueh haroh neu gantoe jih.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Kamu na ureuëng kureuëng. Kamu wajéb [swap X Y] atawa [discard] banda.
invalid.need_drawn_swap: Awak perle kartu nyang ka ditarik keu ji tukeran.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: Neukreuh kartu nyang ka teuek keu neutip.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Posisi luwa baté. Gunayana baré 1-{max_row}, kolom 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Droeneuh hanjeut neugrok ngon kartu nyang ka teuek. Peuseuleusoe kheueh giliran droeneuh leubeh ilée.
